thread:
alex_sales: Quick heads-up - ClearedPoint procurement requested an "assurance bundle" to finalize a 3-week POC. Items: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (their one-page template attached), a one-page network diagram, and a line-item for a short Dedicated trial. They want turnaround in 10 business days. Who can own this?

priya_security: We can produce the redacted SOC2 AOC and the ISO excerpt. If they want unredacted reports that's an NDA + internal disclosure review. For the attestation we need explicit scope text (hostnames/CIDRs) and clarity whether Dedicated is in-scope. Also confirm whether they require scans or will accept uploads.

alex_sales: They attached a template in email and listed scope as "staging.clearedpoint.prod-test" and added "include dedicated pool if used". Procurement indicated they prefer not to sign an NDA for redacted artifacts but may for unredacted.

craig_pricing: Short Dedicated trial pricing: for a 3-week reserved mini-pool expect +18-28% over hosted list depending on GPU SKU. I can produce a quote line-item once we know GPU class. If they convert to Dedicated we can rebate against a commitment.

tom_ops: Operational constraints: active inbound scans require a scheduled maintenance window, source CIDRs, and an emergency kill contact. Presigned uploads are easier and faster. If they insist on peering we need ~5 business days to schedule and test. I can stand up a presigned bucket and runbook once scope is final. Example presign I send to customers:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/clearedpoint/clearedpoint-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll include validators and an emergency contact.

nina_legal: I can sign the pen-test attestation on company letterhead. Preconditions: (1) final scope text (exact hostnames/CIDRs and whether Dedicated is covered), (2) a PO or signed POC cover note referencing the engagement and billing entity. We will sign an attestation only; no indemnities or warranties. Turnaround: 2-3 business days after prerequisites are met.

alex_sales: ClearedPoint procurement prefers hosted staging and uploads, but security may still want to run a zero-day red team test during the POC. I'll ask them to confirm scans vs uploads and push for a PO today.

priya_security: Suggested scope wording for legal: "Scope: testing restricted to staging.clearedpoint.prod-test and associated staging infrastructure for the ClearedPoint POC. Production systems and customer data are expressly out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly purchased and referenced in the PO." Approve?

nina_legal: That language is acceptable. We'll sign once PO or signed POC note is received. If they insist on unredacted SOC2 we'll require NDA and add ~5 business days for internal review.

upload-bot: evidence-system: Presigned evidence bucket standby created: s3://redwood-evidence/clearedpoint/ (pending runbook) :white_check_mark:

tom_ops: I'll finalize the bucket and upload runbook after @alex_sales confirms scope and scan method. Runbook will include allowed windows, presigned upload steps, validators, and an ops contact for kill-switch.

craig_pricing: Once @alex_sales confirms Dedicated yes/no and GPU class I'll post formal PO line-item pricing.

alex_sales: Thanks all. Immediate asks: (1) I'll request PO and confirm scans vs uploads from ClearedPoint procurement/security, (2) if they want Dedicated I'll request GPU class. Expect update by EOD.

priya_security: One more - if the customer requests access to staging KMS artifacts or service account creds to run scans we must decline. They can run scans from their IPs or upload results; we don't hand out keys.

alex_sales: Noted. I'll inform them. Ping me if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
